title: Daily Devotional #24
paragraphs: As I reflect on Matthew chapter 24, I am reminded of the importance of staying alert and prepared for Your return. Jesus warns us about false teachers who will come and deceive many. It is so easy to be misled by those who claim to have the truth but really lead us away from You.

Jesus also tells us about the signs that will precede His coming - wars, rumors of wars, famine, earthquakes, and other natural disasters. These are all indicators that the end is near, and we must be prepared to face them.

Lord, as I read these words, I can't help but feel a sense of urgency. It's easy to get caught up in the distractions of this world, but I know that my time here is temporary. Help me to keep my focus on You and to prioritize my relationship with You above all else.

I am comforted by Jesus' words that no one knows the day or hour of His return, not even the angels in heaven. It is not for me to worry about the exact timing, but rather to be ready for whenever it may happen.

Lord, I pray for the strength and wisdom to discern truth from deception and to remain steadfast in my faith even in the midst of trials and tribulations. May I always be found faithful and prepared when You return.
Thank You for Your love and grace, and for the assurance that You are with me always.
